statusHeadline: Playable prologue and opening missions verified on PC

efforts.name: VIctory-NVIDIA
efforts.summary: An NVIDIA fork of VIctory on readmet3xt-lab's foxhound, with DLSS, frame generation and in-game settings. Verified by PortWatch at 20-30 fps without crashes.
efforts.works: 20 fps without frame generation, no crashes. DLSS upscaling and frame generation 2x to 6x on RTX 40/50 cards.
efforts.blocking: No ray tracing by default (gives ~3 fps if forced). Shader compilation stutters on first run.

efforts.name: DexNom
efforts.summary: DexNom Runtime fork for AMD Radeon (RX 7900 XTX). First build with working ray-traced lighting, translating 25,742 shaders.
efforts.works: Ray-traced lighting working on AMD. High picture fidelity and shader translation passing Microsoft DXIL validator.
efforts.blocking: Heavy performance cost (~1 fps with ray tracing, 3-4 fps without). Interior lighting issues.

efforts.name: Kelvaroq
efforts.summary: Public Rust runtime with measured submission improvements. 36-minute continuous playtest reached the first mission.
efforts.works: Prologue playable at ~10 fps. 36-minute playtest reached first mission without crash under GPL-3.0.
efforts.blocking: CPU submission bottlenecks, missing shader pipelines, 7% dropped draw calls.

efforts.name: hyphennn
efforts.summary: VIctory fork with custom rendering and speed fixes. Prologue plays with ray-traced lighting, high-res textures and hair.
efforts.works: Detailed textures, hair rendering, ray-traced lighting demonstrated on stream.
efforts.blocking: Shadows rendered black, stuck in opening chapter, very low framerate.

efforts.name: Uilian (VItoriaBr)
efforts.summary: VItoriaBr fork reaching Jason's first mission 'Gone Fishing' on live stream with few crashes.
efforts.works: Clears prologue and reaches 'Gone Fishing' mission with gamepad control.
efforts.blocking: Visual artifacts, black or broken textures in complex scenes, occasional crashes.

efforts.name: VIctory (Marvisak)
efforts.summary: Marvis's native Rust layer for GTA VI. Controlled open world gameplay reachable natively.
efforts.works: Loads directly into game world with native Rust execution layer.
efforts.blocking: Unstable framerate (~1 fps in city), crashes during intense particle effects.

efforts.name: XCL
efforts.summary: Wine-style compatibility layer running Xbox Series binary code natively. Gets past menus into the world.
efforts.works: Boots executable, loads main menu and initial world setup cleanly.
efforts.blocking: Hang on loading spinner before 3D rendering kicks in, GPU watchdog timeout.

whatWorks: Executable boots directly into game with full character control and HUD
Physics engine, collision detection, and vehicular handling functional
DLSS and Frame Generation integration working on RTX 40/50 GPUs
In-engine audio, dialogue playback, and vehicle radio stations active
Prologue and opening story missions verified playable without crashes
whatBlocking: Ray tracing global illumination causes severe FPS drops unless disabled
Initial shader compilation stutter across non-NVIDIA GPUs
VRAM memory leak after 45+ minutes of continuous gameplay
Take-Two & Rockstar DMCA notices against public GitHub forks
